title: Set 307

sentences.ko: 그래, 그럼 너 목요일까지 회사에서 못 빠지면 내가 그냥 먼저 비행기 타고 가 있고 네가 거기로 오는 건 어때? 그러면 서로 기다리느라 하루를 통째로 날리지 않아도 되잖아.
sentences.text: Okay, so if you can't get off work until Thursday, why don't I just fly out first and you meet me there? That way we don't lose a whole day waiting on each other.

alts.text: Can't get off till Thursday? Fine, I'll just fly out first and you meet me there. Then we're not wasting a whole day waiting around for each other.
If you are unable to leave work until Thursday, perhaps I could fly out first and you could meet me there. That way, we would not lose an entire day waiting for each other.

sentences.note: **get off work** 는 퇴근하다, 회사에서 빠져나오다라는 뜻이에요. **why don't I** 는 내가 ~할까?처럼 내 쪽에서 제안할 때 쓰고, **fly out** 은 비행기 타고 떠나다예요.

sentences.ko: 알아, 알아, 늦었지. 그 발표 자료 끝내느라 너무 늦게까지 안 자서 알람 울리는 것도 모르고 계속 잤나 봐. 그래서 커피 마실 시간도 없었어.
sentences.text: I know, I know, I'm late. I was up way too late finishing that presentation, and I guess I slept right through my alarm, so I didn't even have time for coffee.

alts.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm late, I know. Stayed up way too late doing that presentation and totally slept through my alarm, so I didn't even get to grab coffee.
I am aware that I am late, and I apologize. I stayed up far too late finishing the presentation, and I must have slept through my alarm, so I did not even have time for coffee.

sentences.note: **slept right through my alarm** 은 알람이 울리는데도 모르고 계속 잤다는 말이에요. **way too late** 의 way 는 too 를 더 세게 만들어서 너무너무 늦게라는 느낌을 줘요.

sentences.ko: 저기, 또 귀찮게 해서 죄송한데요, 샤워기에서 아직도 찬물만 나와요. 지난주에 보내 주신 기사님이 부품 가지고 다시 오신다고 했는데 아무도 안 왔어요. 혹시 저 대신 그분한테 전화 좀 해 주실 수 있을까요?
sentences.text: Hey, sorry to bug you again, but the shower's still only running cold. The guy you sent last week said he'd come back with a part, but nobody ever showed up, so could you maybe call him for me?

alts.text: Sorry, me again! Shower's still ice cold. The guy from last week said he'd be back with a part, but he never came, so could you give him a call for me?

I apologize for disturbing you again, but the shower is still producing only cold water. The technician you sent last week said he would return with a part, but no one ever came, so would you be able to contact him on my behalf?

sentences.note: **sorry to bug you** 는 귀찮게 해서 미안하다는 편한 말이에요. **showed up** 은 나타나다, 오다라는 뜻이고 **running cold** 는 물이 차갑게 나온다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 집주인이랑 고장 난 것 고쳐 달라고 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 네가 말했던 그 이탈리안 식당 가 봤어. 파스타는 진짜 맛있었는데 안이 너무 시끄러워서 서로 말소리도 안 들리더라. 그래서 다음엔 그냥 포장해 올까 봐.
sentences.text: We went to that Italian place you were talking about. The pasta was really good, but it was so loud in there we couldn't even hear each other, so next time I think we'll just get it to go.

alts.text: So we tried that Italian place you told us about. Pasta was great, but it was crazy loud, we couldn't hear a thing, so next time we're probably just gonna get takeout.
We visited the Italian restaurant you had mentioned. The pasta was excellent, but it was so noisy inside that we could not hear one another, so next time I believe we will simply order it to go.

sentences.note: **get it to go** 는 음식을 포장해 가다라는 뜻이에요. casual 의 **get takeout** 도 같은 뜻으로 많이 써요.
sentences.situation: 친구가 추천한 식당 다녀와서 후기 말하기

sentences.ko: 솔직히 아무것도 안 하려고 했는데, 토요일에 여동생이 전화해서 이사하는 것 좀 도와 달라고 하는 거야. 그래서 주말 내내 박스 들고 계단으로 3층까지 날랐어. 아직도 허리가 너무 아파.
sentences.text: Honestly, I was going to do nothing, but my sister called on Saturday and needed help moving, so I spent the whole weekend carrying boxes up three flights of stairs. My back's still killing me.

alts.text: I was gonna do nothing, honestly, but my sister called Saturday and needed help moving, so I was hauling boxes up three flights of stairs all weekend. My back's still killing me.

To be honest, I had planned to do nothing, but my sister called on Saturday and needed help moving, so I spent the entire weekend carrying boxes up three flights of stairs. My back is still very sore.

sentences.note: **killing me** 는 너무 아파 죽겠다는 말이에요. **three flights of stairs** 는 계단 세 층을 뜻하고, **needed help moving** 은 이사하는 데 도움이 필요했다는 말이에요.

reviewed: 3번 casual 의 Shower's still cold only 는 원어민이 안 하는 어순이라 Shower's still ice cold 로 고침
4번 formal 의 order it to take away 는 영국식이고 text 의 to go 와 동떨어져 order it to go 로 맞춤
4번 한국어 너가 를 네가 로 고침
5번 한국어 계단 3층을 오르내렸어 는 영어(박스를 들고 3층까지 올렸다)와 뜻이 달라 계단으로 3층까지 날랐어 로 고침
